item.title: How IDF helicopter crews reach wounded soldiers in the heart of battle
item.summary: As troops fight Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, Israeli Air Force crews and Unit 669 carry out high-risk rescue missions, landing under fire to evacuate wounded soldiers as quickly as possible; 'We as pilots can literally see the enemy with our own eyes'

item.title: Lebanese president urges talks with Israel as IDF strikes Hezbollah targets in Beirut’s Dahieh
item.summary: Joseph Aoun says negotiations are the only way to stop devastation as Israel expands strikes against Hezbollah; no ceasefire response yet, he says, warning Lebanon risks the fate of Gaza while regional tensions continue to escalate

item.title: Israel braces for major escalation as Trump’s Iran deadline nears
item.summary: With Trump’s ultimatum set to expire early Wednesday Israel time, officials are preparing for possible strikes on Iranian energy and infrastructure targets, even as mediators race to secure a last-minute deal and avert a wider regional war

item.title: Trump: ‘We got him’ after US commando rescue of downed navigator deep inside Iran under heavy fire
item.summary: US forces carried out two-day operation involving hundreds of troops, airstrikes and firefights to extract F-15E navigator; aircraft malfunction forced dramatic changes as all forces exited Iran safely, officials say

item.title: Israel set to start striking energy facilities in Iran next week, official says
item.summary: Senior defense official tells Reuters Jerusalem is waiting for green light from US as Donald Trump issues 48-hour ultimatum to Tehran

item.title: Haifa missile strike tests rescuers in exceptionally complex operation
item.summary: Emergency crews and Home Front Command units spent hours working through unstable rubble at a collapsed residential building, where terrain and an unexploded Iranian missile added to the danger

item.title: Woman seriously wounded after Iranian missile barrage on central Israel
item.summary: At least two other people were wounded in Tel Aviv; authorities said at least one of the missiles was a cluster-type munition, prompting searches for several possible impact sites

item.title: More than 10 impact sites reported in Haifa after latest barrage; no injuries reported
item.summary: Sirens sound in Haifa area following launches from Iran after multiple waves hit central Israel earlier

item.title: 2 bodies recovered after Iran missile strike on Haifa home, 2 still missing
item.summary: Rescue teams worked through the night, recovering two bodies from under the rubble while continuing the search for two people still unaccounted for; 82-year-old man in serious condition and taken into surgery; 8 other people lightly wounded, including a baby

item.title: From automatic support to political risk: Israel is now a burden for Democratic Party candidates
item.summary: Less than three year to US presidential elections and just a few months before the midterms, almost all Democratic leaders are making clear their aversion to Israel and openly talking about breaking away from it - and are saying things about Israel that were once unimaginable

item.title: Israelis suspected of making explosives for Iran, police say
item.summary: Authorities say suspects provided services to Iranian actors and were instructed to produce explosive materials; investigators say the suspects also carried out experiments using the materials they manufactured

item.title: Hamas faces make-or-break decision on Gaza disarmament plan, official says
item.summary: US-backed proposal would require Hamas to surrender weapons in stages, allow outside oversight and link Israeli withdrawal to verified disarmament and reconstruction in Gaza

item.title: Neot Hovav industrial zone hit for third time in Iran war
item.summary: Last week, a missile hit the Adama chemical plant, causing extensive damage and lightly injuring six people, as fears of a hazardous materials leak forced workers to shelter while dozens of crews battled the blaze for hours

item.title: 'We pressed the fight — and lost our best': IDF commander recounts deadly Hezbollah Lebanon encounter
item.summary: Four soldiers were killed last week in a close-range clash inside a fortified Hezbollah compound in southern Lebanon, as their commander, Lt. Col. 'S,' recounts the battle, the loss and the unit’s determination to continue the mission

item.title: This is how Iran's underground missile cities operate: Massive bunkers protect large missile stockpile
item.summary: According to intelligence estimates, Iran has thousands of drones, many cruise missiles and about half of its launchers left, in part because of its underground bases; The Yazd base is buried 500 meters inside a mountain, making it hard even for a US bunker buster bomb to hit it

item.title: IDF soldier killed by friendly fire in southern Lebanon, second seriously wounded
item.summary: The incident occurred during an operation by a Maglan unit to arrest a Hezbollah-linked suspect in an area of ongoing targeted IDF activity in southern Lebanon, with the circumstances of the friendly fire under investigation

item.title: US appeals court reinstates $655M terror verdict against PLO, Palestinian Authority
item.summary: Ruling revives 2015 jury award to American victims of Second Intifada attacks after the Supreme Court cleared the way for US courts to hear the case, including over the Palestinian Authority’s 'pay for slay' payments policy

item.title: Thick black smoke from mystery package at Ben Gurion Airport sparks hazmat alert, workers evacuated
item.summary: Emergency crews rushed to Israel’s main airport after a package from abroad began emitting dense black smoke; hazardous materials unit deployed amid fears of toxic substance, workers evacuated as officials say situation under control with no injuries

item.title: 4.5 magnitude earthquake felt across northern Israel, no injuries reported
item.summary: According to the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre, the quake struck in the Mediterranean Sea at a depth of 14 kilometers, off the coast of Tyre and Sidon in southern Lebanon

item.title: Palestinian posed as Mossad agent, pilot — extorted Golan woman: 'Sent nude video to husband'
item.summary: Suspect allegedly used a fake identity and AI-generated videos to gain the victim’s trust, secretly filmed intimate encounters and threatened to expose them, extorting tens of thousands of shekels before his arrest in a police undercover operation
